meta.title: Push
meta.description: Pushes DSH completions, pauses, failures, approvals, questions and task progress to WeChat and WeCom, with replies, conversation continuation and proactive pushes.

page.title: Push
page.hint: Configure channels, default routing and triggers. Save applies immediately.

ui.loadFailed: Could not load the push configuration

global.enabledHint: When off, no notification is sent and chat commands are ignored
global.titlePrefixHint: Prepended to every notification title, e.g. [DSH]; leave empty for none
global.mainAgentOnlyHint: Subagent completions and progress stay silent; approvals and questions are still delivered

events.hint: Choose which events send a push.

channels.hint: Enable at least one channel and fill in its credentials.

wechat.title: WeChat
wechat.interactiveHint: When off, pushes are sent but replies are ignored
wechat.defaultTargetsHint: Leave empty to reach whoever messaged the bot most recently
wechat.scanHint: Scan the QR code with WeChat. Send the bot one message after logging in so pushes can reach you.
wechat.noTargets: Nobody has messaged the bot yet
wechat.loginStarted: Login started; the QR code appears shortly
wechat.disabledHint: Disabled (binding turns it on and starts the scan)

wecomAibot.title: WeCom AI bot
wecomAibot.interactiveHint: When off, pushes are sent but replies are ignored
wecomAibot.defaultTargetsHint: A userid for direct chat or a chatid for groups; empty reaches recent chats
wecomAibot.qrHint: Scan with WeCom to fill in the Bot ID and Secret
wecomAibot.qrExpired: The QR code expired; start again
wecomAibot.qrDone: Associated; Bot ID and Secret were filled in
wecomAibot.qrStarted: Association started; the QR code appears shortly

wecomWebhook.title: WeCom group bot
wecomWebhook.mentionsHint: userid or @all, comma separated; text messages only

defaultChannel.title: Default channel
defaultChannel.hint: Proactive pushes without a channel go here only; when it is unavailable the push fails instead of moving to another channel.

push.replyTimeoutHint: Longest wait when push_message asks for a reply; 300000 maximum

messages.localeHint: Language of messages sent to chat, independent of this page
messages.hintHint: Append a line telling the reader that replying continues the conversation

channel.noTargetHint: No known chat yet: message the bot once

deliveries.title: Recent deliveries
deliveries.hint: One row per outbound attempt: time · channel/target · result. This is how you tell whether a message actually left.

system.title: System notifications
system.enabledHint: Session events raise an OS notification (macOS / Linux / Windows) instead of going through WeChat or WeCom.
system.soundHint: Play a short cue with each notification (synthesized by the page, not the OS; silent while this page is closed)
system.events: Events that raise a system notification
system.eventsHint: Independent of the event switches under General: this only decides which events also pop an OS notification.
system.permissionUnsupported: This page has no Notification API
system.testBody: From the DSH push center; seeing this means notifications work.
system.guidanceBrowser: If nothing appeared, check two places: allow notifications for this site in the browser's address-bar controls, and allow that browser in the OS (macOS: System Settings → Notifications → your browser; Windows: Settings → System → Notifications).

ui.autoChannel.title: Automatic recipient
ui.autoChannel.hint: Event notifications, approvals and questions go to this channel only
